title: ZOI Hat Mod Resource Pack
description: ZOI Hat Mod Resource pack, players may swap out the conventional carved pumpkin texture for the chic and recognizable ZOI Hat in Minecraft.
body: [inZOI Mod](https://modinzoi.com/) Hat Resource Pack, players may swap out the conventional carved pumpkin texture for the chic and recognizable ZOI Hat in Minecraft. The [inZOI CC](https://inzoiresource.com/) improves the player's image by acting as a stylish and identifiable accessory. This gives the game a unique and lively touch that enhances its enjoyment and visual appeal. All in all, this pack is ideal for anyone wishing to add a distinctive accessory to their Minecraft experience or for lovers of the ZOI.
